ana (PM): quick sync — customers asking for multiplexed WS + per-request QoS and a strict finish-reason contract. do we want a single canonical enum for finish reasons or freeform codes?

mike (eng): single enum + optional freeform detail field please. enums for client-side routing/metrics.

sam (runtime): agreed on enum. need to decide semantics: is "done" only when final token sent or when connection-level EOF? also how to represent partial structured output failures.

ana (PM): (typo) meant ana. good q. propose: FINISH_REASON = {completed, cancelled, timeout, cutoff, model_error, mismatch_schema, truncated_cache}. detail string for human/debug.

mike (eng): how about "cutoff" vs "truncated_cache" overlap? cutoff = policy cutoff (e.g., max_tokens), truncated_cache = kv-cache eviction.

sam (runtime): +1. runtime needs to map backend variants -> these enums deterministically. also need numeric finish_codes for perf telemetry (small ints).

kevin (sdk): on the wire for SSE/WS deltas: we currently emit events like `delta`, `role`, `done`. If we add finish_reason we should include it on the final delta event, e.g.:

```json
{ "type": "delta", "token": "..." }
{ "type": "delta", "token": "..." }
{ "type": "done", "finish_reason": "timeout", "finish_code": 3, "detail": "server qps limit" }
```

kevin (sdk): for multiplexing (many requests per connection) we need per-request ids in every event. otherwise can't jrm. e.g. `req_id` header on connect or per-message.

mike (eng): yes req_id mandatory. also we should support priority tag for routing: `qos: high|normal|low` attached to initial start message. runtime will use it for scheduling and preemption.

ana (PM): ana again. customers want clear retry guidance: when is it safe to replay a request vs when stateful tool calls prevent it?

sam (runtime): safe-to-retry decisions: if finish_reason is model_error or timeout -> idempotent retries possible but must respect max-attempts and backoff. if finish_reason == cancelled_by_tool or mismatch_schema -> don't auto-retry. docs should call these out.

lina (docs): I'll draft a compact table mapping finish_reason -> retry_policy + SDK hints. want canonical names and short descriptions.

kevin (sdk): SDK surfaces: 1) delta stream with per-message req_id, 2) final event includes finish_reason and finish_code, 3) resume token support when finish_reason == truncated_cache, 4) WebSocket multiplexing example in README.

mike (eng): resume token: expensive to guarantee across model variants. runtime can offer best-effort. resume only for same model + quantization + KV state compatibility. should we expose `resume_supported: boolean` in start ack?

sam (runtime): yes include `resume_supported` in session ack. if false clients shouldn't attempt resume. and `resume_token` format must be opaque.

ops-bot: deploy:canary passed for branch streaming-qos-priority (build 9823) :white_check_mark:

ana (PM): launch gates proposal:
- API: per-message req_id, final event finish_reason + code (required)
- Runtime: deterministic mapping from backend signals to enum + resume_supported flag
- SDK: example for WS multiplexing + resume best-practice + retry table
- Docs: table and short migration guide for existing users

mike (eng): timeline wise: backend enum + telemetry mapping (2 sprints), wire format + SDK samples (1 sprint), docs (1 sprint). can we do staggered rollout? e.g., wire accepts legacy `done` and new `done` simultaneously for 4 weeks.

an a (PM): ana — yes staggered is preferred. add an opt-in header `X-Stream-V2: true` during rollout. default stays legacy for 4 weeks.

kevin (sdk): agree on opt-in header. I'll add SDK flag `streamV2: true` to opt in from day 1.

lina (docs): will note migration steps and example with `X-Stream-V2`. also include a minimal WS multiplex snippet: 

```
CONNECT /ws HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: rwd-stream-v2
{ "auth": "Bearer ..." }

-> on messages: { "req_id": "r-123", "type": "delta", "token": "Hi" }
-> final: { "req_id": "r-123", "type": "done", "finish_reason": "completed", "finish_code": 0 }
```

mike (eng): open question: do we add `priority` into per-message resume tokens or only initial start? prefer initial only.

sam (runtime): initial only. priority can be updated via control message but not recommended.

ana (PM): OK. next steps: mike/sam write the enum spec + mapping doc. kevin add SDK opt-in flag + WS example. lina draft the retry table + migration guide. i'll schedule a 30m sync next wed to sign off.

kevin (sdk): quick note: mobile SDKs may prefer ExponentialBackoff with jitter + `maxAttempts=2` default for timeouts. will add to samples.

mike (eng): bumped scope: 1) enforce req_id, 2) final event semantics, 3) opt-in header. any objections?

sam (runtime): none from runtime.

lina (docs): none.

ana (PM): cool. locking these as launch criteria in the doc. thanks all :thumbsup:

kevin (sdk): +1

ops-bot: reminder: RFC draft due in 3 days for streaming-finishreason (assignee: mike)

ana (PM): noted. I'll add customer examples to RFC.

mike (eng): starting enum PR today.

lina (docs): will pair with kevin on samples tomorrow.

ana (PM): end.
